message: a zi_* filter with {count} more zero(s) at the origin than poles at the origin is an advance of {count} sample(s), which no causal filter can produce (LRM 4.5.12)
description: A root at the origin is a factor z, a one-sample advance. More such zeros than poles asks the filter for future input samples.
actions: Remove zeros at the origin, or add poles at the origin to delay the output instead.
